name: CodeAnt AI
tagline: PR reviewer with severity-ranked comments and one-click fixes across GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, and Azure DevOps, plus SAST scanning.
pricing: 14-day free trial (100 PR reviews); Premium $24/user/mo (billing toggle also shows $30); Enterprise custom. Free for open source
selfHostedNote: On-prem/VPC deployment on Enterprise; also connects to self-hosted SCMs (GHES, GitLab self-managed, Bitbucket DC).
modelControl: Fixed vendor models; no BYOK or model selection documented

01-multi-dimensional-context.note: Vendor blog describes LSP-driven graph exploration beyond the diff; not covered in product docs.

02-rule-centric.note: Custom rules, instructions, personas, org-wide .codeant config; threshold limits output to critical issues.

03-dual-workflow.note: IDE extensions (VS Code, Cursor, JetBrains, more), CLI review, and git hooks alongside PR reviews.

04-business-logic.note: Jira Ticket Compliance cross-verifies ticket requirements against the PR (compliant/partial/non-compliant).

05-continuous-learning.note: Learnings feature: teach the reviewer about your codebase by dismissing suggestions.

06-sandbox-validation.note: No documented code execution, test runs, or sandbox validation.

07-economic-transparency.note: Seat-based pricing; no BYOK, model choice, or token cost visibility documented.

08-actionability.note: One-click commit suggestion, Autofix, fix-in-IDE, and AI-agent prompt handoff.

09-measurable-roi.note: DORA metrics, developer productivity dashboards, and a developer-metrics API are documented.
